title: Capturing and rearranging date text
description: You can inspect captured fields and reuse them in replacements.

steps.description: The first match captures year, month and day as groups 1, 2 and 3. You see group 0 contain the whole date and the month occupy span (5, 7).
Grouping keeps the month alternatives inside the date pattern. The non-capturing year group later leaves month as group 1.

steps.question: Does this ISO pattern reject 2026-02-31?
steps.answer: No. It accepts the separate month and day ranges, so this supplied fullmatch prints True without checking calendar validity.

steps.description: Raw replacement strings reuse captured text in day-month-year order. You see numbered and named references produce the same converted sentence.
Word boundaries protect the longer numbers in noisy. You see only the standalone date change when boundaries surround ISO.
The final replacements retain selected context, change years and use a month-name dictionary. You see Sep, Oct and Nov in the function-based result.
